messages:
maria (CS): FYI customer reported a quantized endpoint performing worse than their fp16 baseline after our calibration push. p95 jumped from ~120ms to ~260ms. They see higher token time and worse top-k. 
lee (Runtime): Can you paste the endpoint id and model version?
 maria (CS): endpoint=acme-gen-2, model=redwood-v2-4bit-calib-2026-03, root ts 1842005510, repro script attached (short input, batch=1). They ran 5k requests.
lee (Runtime): OK pulling traces. jamal, can you check node-level metrics?
jamal (SRE): Looking at prometheus: quant-pool CPU/GPU utilization is normal, but NVTX shows increased kernel launch times for attention. p95 kernel latency for matmul increased 2.1x. snippet: ```
# nvtx summary
kernel: matmul_q (int4) p50 0.9ms p95 3.8ms p99 7.2ms
kernel: matmul_fp16 p50 0.7ms p95 1.8ms p99 3.0ms
```
priya (ML): Interesting — calibration updated per-layer scale factors; maybe we hit a slow fallback path in the quantized matmul for certain sequence lengths or kv-cache shapes. Did the runtime switch to a different kernel?
lee (Runtime): Runtime logs show kernel selector switched from int4_fast to int4_precise for those sequences. Selector rule: if per-token loss of quantized kernel > threshold, prefer precise kernel. But I don't see loss spikes in requests. Attaching snippet: ```
[2026-03-18T15:45:12Z] selector: int4_fast -> int4_precise (seq_len=128, kv_len=4096, cache_hits=0)
[2026-03-18T15:45:12Z] kernel_launch matmul_precise int4 (lat 4.1ms)
```
olivia (Solutions): The customer said latency regressed right after we pushed the global calibration bundle on 03-17. Can we roll that back per-tenant?
maria (CS): They're requesting immediate rollback if we can't mitigate quickly.
lee (Runtime): We have a per-endpoint override flag. Quick mitigation: force kernel preference to fp16 for acme-gen-2 while we debug. That avoids quantized path entirely. Impact: higher token cost but avoids perf regression.
priya (ML): Before rollback, let's quickly test a narrower mitigation: disable the 'precise' int4 kernel to force the fast int4 path. If precise is slow on their hardware patterns, disabling it might help. But risk of quality drop.
jamal (SRE): Ops note: deploying kernel override requires a tiny config push via control plane. I can run a canary (single node) and measure p95.
deploy-bot: started deployment 1842006021 -> config: {"acme-gen-2": {"kernel_override": "force_fp16"}}
lee (Runtime): Canary results (10k reqs, batch=1): forced_fp16 p95=140ms, int4_precise p95=260ms, int4_fast p95=130ms (but int4_fast quality regression for certain prompts). Screenshot of perf dashboard attached.
priya (ML): So int4_fast is actually faster than fp16, but our selector was choosing precise which is slow. Two hypotheses: 1) calibration changed quant scales making precise codepath do extra dequant/requant work; 2) KV cache layout after long context triggers a less-optimized matmul tiling for precise kernel.
lee (Runtime): I found a codepath where, when scale variance > 0.07 across heads, we fall back to matmul_precise which currently calls a reference kernel with extra packing. That could be the perf culprit. I can hotfix to use a packed kernel variant instead of reference.
jamal (SRE): Customer-facing action: rollback to fp16 is live for acme-gen-2 (1842006120). Maria, please update the CS thread.
maria (CS): Drafting TL;DR: "We've temporarily routed your traffic to the fp16 variant to restore latency while we investigate. No data changes. Expect cost delta; we're happy to discuss credits." sending to customer now. :thumbsup:
lee (Runtime): I'll open a PR to change selector to consider kernel throughput benchmark for the observed kv shapes and add a safety timeout (if precise >1.5x fp16 for 5k samples, fallback). Priya, can you run microbenchmarks for the calibration bundle against our kernel matrix?
priya (ML): On it. I'll run across seq_len {32,128,512} and kv cache sizes {0,2048,4096}. Will post a table.
jamal (SRE): Logging notes: creating incident-184200 to track RCA and customer comms.
maria (CS): Customer acknowledged the temporary routing and appreciates the quick mitigation. They want ETA for permanent fix. I'll keep them updated.
lee (Runtime): Plan: (1) revert per-tenant to fp16 (done), (2) add quick selector heuristic change + packed kernel fallback (hotfix PR), (3) validate calibration bundle impact in perf lab, (4) postmortem + opt-in quant calibration for customers until we have robust kernel coverage.
priya (ML): Preliminary microbench: int4_precise matmul has ~2.3x higher L2 misses on kv_len 4096 vs fp16; looks like memory layout mismatch. Sending flamegraph and perf counters.
lee (Runtime): Thanks. I'll prepare the hotfix and coordinate deploy with jamal. Keeping this thread as the handover for customer ops.
maria (CS): Thanks all — will update customer and product. Next update in 60m unless blocked.
jamal (SRE): incident-184200 created, owners assigned.
lee (Runtime): marking follow-up tasks in the sprint.
deploy-bot: deployment complete 1842006225 -> config: {"acme-gen-2": {"kernel_override": "force_fp16"}}
olivia (Solutions): If we need to offer a longer-term workaround, we can propose a dedicated quantization pilot with controlled calibration and perf gates.
maria (CS): noted. Closing loop after RCA.
